description: Validated CV model weights per modality. Place files under MODEL_WEIGHTS_DIR after clinical validation.

monai-unet.task: organ segmentation (spleen) — NOT lung nodule detection

weights.CT: spleen_ct_segmentation/ (full bundle dir: configs/ + models/model.pt, fetched via monai.bundle.download)

monai-unet.notes: Weights present on disk does NOT enable this backend — see clinical_use_gate_env. MRI intentionally not wired (no standardized single-sequence Model Zoo bundle); a medical director must select one before implementation. Only used as a fallback in engine.py when neither totalsegmentator nor lung_nodule_detection is approved (least informative of the three CT backends). True lung-nodule *detection* is now implemented separately — see lung_nodule_detection below.

totalsegmentator.task: whole-body organ segmentation, 117 classes ('total' task, fast/3mm model)
totalsegmentator.source: TotalSegmentator (Wasserthal et al.) — pip package, self-downloads its own nnU-Net weights on first run
totalsegmentator.weights: auto-download to TOTALSEG_WEIGHTS_PATH/Dataset297_TotalSegmentator_total_3mm_1559subj on first approved use, or pre-fetch via scripts/download_weights.py --warmup-totalsegmentator
totalsegmentator.notes: Weights present on disk does NOT enable this backend — see clinical_use_gate_env. confidence_score is a coverage-based heuristic (organs found vs expected), NOT a per-voxel probability — this model's simple Python API returns hard labels only. Tried before the single-organ MONAI spleen bundle in the routing chain since it covers more organs.

lung_nodule_detection.task: 3D lung nodule detection (discrete candidate boxes + scores), NOT segmentation
lung_nodule_detection.source: MONAI Model Zoo bundle 'lung_nodule_ct_detection' — RetinaNet + ResNet50-3D-FPN, trained on LUNA16
lung_nodule_detection.weights: lung_nodule_ct_detection/ (full bundle dir, fetched via monai.bundle.download)
lung_nodule_detection.notes: Weights present on disk does NOT enable this backend. Runs in engine.py's CT multi-model merge alongside totalsegmentator (organ boundaries + discrete nodule candidates are complementary, both included in the merged result when both are approved). Sliding-window ROI reduced from the bundle's own default (512,512,192) to (96,96,48) for CPU tractability — a tuning choice that itself needs validation, not assumed equivalent to the bundle's documented config. Box coordinates are voxel-space, not yet transformed to patient world coordinates (needs full DICOM affine, only approximated here).

breast_density_classification.task: BI-RADS breast density classification (A-D), NOT lesion/malignancy detection
breast_density_classification.weights: breast_density_classification/ (full bundle dir, fetched via monai.bundle.download)
breast_density_classification.notes: Weights present on disk does NOT enable this backend. Single 2D image classification (not volumetric) — mammography goes through the existing single-instance DICOM fetch path, no series/volume assembly needed. Density category only, explicitly not framed as a cancer-detection output.
